sections.title: Home Improvement Retail (Home Depot)
sections.description: For Home Depot (Atlanta HQ) and the home improvement retail ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Pro contractor analytics
paragraphs: ML for Home Depot's enormous professional contractor customer base — predicting which contractors are growing vs. declining, identifying upsell opportunities for large project materials, and personalizing the Pro experience for the contractors who represent 45%+ of Home Depot's revenue.

blocks.heading: Supply chain demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for Home Depot's complex product demand — home improvement spending patterns are driven by housing market conditions, weather (storm prep and post-storm repair), and regional construction activity that generic retail demand models underperform on.

blocks.heading: Vendor analytics and merchandising
paragraphs: ML for category management and vendor performance for Home Depot's large supplier community — identifying which SKUs are underperforming, predicting seasonal demand by category, and optimizing assortment decisions for Home Depot's 2,300+ US stores.

sections.title: Grocery and Food Retail (Kroger Atlanta Division)
sections.description: Kroger's Atlanta division serves one of the US's most diverse metropolitan grocery markets.

blocks.heading: Atlanta-specific demand modeling
paragraphs: ML calibrated to Atlanta's neighborhood-level demographic diversity — the specific grocery demand patterns of Atlanta's diverse neighborhoods (Buckhead's premium preferences, Southwest Atlanta's value-orientation, Atlanta's large Asian and African American consumer communities) require localized demand models.

blocks.heading: Fresh food inventory optimization
paragraphs: ML for Kroger's Atlanta fresh food operations — perishable demand prediction that minimizes waste while preventing stockout in Atlanta's high-volume fresh departments.

blocks.heading: Kroger loyalty analytics
paragraphs: ML for Kroger's Atlanta Shopper's Card loyalty program — personalized digital coupons, churn prediction, and basket expansion for Atlanta's Kroger shoppers.

sections.title: Retail Technology (NCR Voyix)
sections.description: NCR Voyix (Atlanta HQ) — global retail and hospitality technology serving 150,000+ merchants.

blocks.heading: Self-checkout optimization
paragraphs: ML for NCR Voyix's enormous installed self-checkout base — predicting which lanes are likely to experience fraud, optimizing intervention timing, and personalizing the checkout experience based on return customer patterns.

blocks.heading: Merchant analytics platform
paragraphs: ML for NCR's merchant intelligence platform — demand forecasting, competitive benchmarking, and growth opportunity identification for the small and medium retailers using NCR's technology.

blocks.heading: Restaurant technology AI
paragraphs: ML for NCR Voyix's large hospitality technology customer base (restaurant POS, kitchen display systems) — menu performance, prep time optimization, and server performance analytics.

sections.title: Children's Apparel (Carter's)
sections.description: Carter's (Atlanta HQ) — the US's largest branded marketer of children's clothing.

blocks.heading: Children's apparel demand forecasting
paragraphs: ML for children's clothing demand incorporating birth rate trends, gifting seasonality (baby showers, holidays, first day of school), and the growth pattern of Carter's own customer base as parents return for each size tier.

blocks.heading: DTC personalization
paragraphs: Recommendation and personalization ML for Carter's growing direct-to-consumer digital channel — recognizing returning parents and anticipating the next size tier purchase.

sections.title: Atlanta's retail AI market momentum
sections.description: Atlanta's retail AI market is accelerating for specific reasons beyond Home Depot's dominance.

blocks.heading: Cardlytics' purchase-based advertising AI
paragraphs: Cardlytics (Atlanta HQ) processes purchase data from the banking apps of major US banks — enabling purchase-based advertising targeting. As Cardlytics' platform has grown to hundreds of millions of US consumer banking accounts, the retail measurement AI demand — proving that advertising on Cardlytics' platform drove incremental purchase behavior — has made Atlanta a center of retail measurement innovation.

blocks.heading: NCR Voyix's retail technology scale
paragraphs: After the NCR split, NCR Voyix's retail technology focus has created a concentrated retail technology AI market in Atlanta that is unmatched outside Silicon Valley. The combination of NCR's enormous merchant customer base and its Atlanta engineering organization makes Atlanta the second-most important US city for retail technology AI.

blocks.heading: Peach State's manufacturing food brands
paragraphs: The food and consumer goods manufacturing in Georgia surrounding Atlanta — Chick-fil-A (College Park GA HQ), Waffle House (Norcross GA HQ), and the large food manufacturers in Atlanta's periphery — create retail supply chain AI demand that extends beyond the downtown Atlanta Fortune 500 headquarters.
